title: Official Jenkins Docker image
descript: The Jenkins Continuous Integration and Delivery server. Packaged for TerraMaster TOS 7: the official Docker Hub image runs as a container on your NAS, keeps its data in the application data folder (so it survives restarts and updates), and is opened from its desktop icon.
important: First run: open the web UI and complete the initial setup. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/jenkinsdocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000, so mounted folders must be readable by that user. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

zh-cn.descript: 持续集成/持续交付服务器，支持流水线与插件。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/jenkinsdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。

zh-hk.important: 首次使用請開啟網頁完成初始化。資料保存在 DockerAppData/jenkinsdocker，重新啟動和升級不會遺失。容器以 uid 1000 運行，掛載目錄需對該使用者可讀。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可達時先設定鏡像加速。解除安裝並刪除資料前請備份。區域網路內為 HTTP。
